scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
other_conditions: Applicant must not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme
Application should be submitted within the prescribed period, if any
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly pension of ₹1,000 to eligible BPL individuals with severe or multiple disabilities.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all necessary documents
Acknowledgement receipt (or photocopy of the filled application form)
